title: chrome finish organizer
text:
chrome finish organizer. UPDATE: 5/21/2021 Yikes. The legs have totally RUSTED. The baskets rusted. And there wasn't a leak or any thing!! These started out OK... but I had to update. AVOID this purchase.
After a minor remodel in my bathroom I decided the under sink area needed better organization. They are pretty chinsy.. don't feel super quality.. but...NO TOOLS. The legs just pop in with press and lock in place. So relieved I didn't have to build the whole thing. They are going to work great I think - however, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. I purchased 2. I can't stack them due to the height, but you can stack them too.
